title: SANKET: A Wrist-Worn ESP32-S3 TinyML System for Bangla Deaf-Aid Air-Written Gesture Recognition
description: SANKET (সংকেত, 'signal / gesture') is a wrist-worn embedded AI system that lets a Deaf person air-write a Bangla word with their wrist and have the device recognize it on-chip in real time. Hardware: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (N16R8) + MPU6050 IMU, bill of materials under US $7. Firmware runs a quantized int8 1D-CNN via esp-tflite-micro with esp-nn ESP32-S3 vector-ISA acceleration. A dual-core sampling + inference architecture guarantees uninterrupted 100 Hz IMU sampling. First open-source Bangla air-written gesture recognition system that runs entirely on an edge microcontroller.
notes: This repository and the accompanying technical disclosure (zenodo/SANKET_disclosure.pdf) are published as a defensive publication to establish prior art for the system described.
